title.en: the distillery winter village, friday evening.

line.en: the christmas market is open until 3 january. entry is free off-peak; paid tickets apply at peak hours, so come early.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt ist bis 3. januar geöffnet. der eintritt ist außerhalb der stoßzeiten frei; zu stoßzeiten gibt es bezahlte tickets, also früh kommen.
line.tr: noel pazarı 3 ocak'a kadar açık. yoğun saatlerin dışında giriş ücretsiz; yoğun saatlerde ücretli bilet gerekiyor, bu yüzden erken gel.

sparks.why: Distillery Winter Village 2026, 12 Nov to 3 Jan, open daily from 10:00 per the official schedule (thedistillerywintervillage.com); admission per todocanada and newswire.ca.
